## Progress Update — WhatsApp Message Scheduler Bot Plan

- **Survey Phase Research Completed**: All 3 specialized explorer agents have concluded their deep-dive investigations and delivered comprehensive technical reports and handoffs.
- **Platform Feasibility & Trade-Offs Analyzed**: Detailed comparative analyses have been produced for the official WhatsApp Cloud API (24-hour customer service window, pre-approved message templates, per-conversation/message costs) versus personal account web automation via Baileys/Noise protocol (pairing codes, companion device limits, multi-tenant session persistence, anti-ban mitigations).
- **Conversational & Scheduling Architecture Specified**: Complete specifications have been drafted for conversational dialog state machines (interactive wizard vs. fast-path commands), relational data persistence schemas, distributed job queues (BullMQ/Redis with advisory locking), and failure resilience (misfire recovery, network downtime, timezone/DST handling).
- **Synthesis Underway**: The Project Orchestrator is now synthesizing the findings into the core project scope, milestone roadmap, and formal implementation plan.
